meta.purpose: restore miles on US gas lengths the sheet holds as km conversions of source mile figures

verifications.note: the October 2018 planned projects table in Pipeline and Gas Journal
a Natural Gas Intelligence news story on the Mountaineer expansion plan

resolutions.researcher_notes: Units restored. The sheet held 44.3 km, which is a conversion of the miles the source states. The Pipeline and Gas Journal table lists Mountaineer Gas Pipeline Phase I at 27.5 miles. A Natural Gas Intelligence story gives the first segment as 27.5 miles. The sheet figure of 44.3 km is 27.5 miles, so it is a conversion. A West Virginia Public Broadcasting story says 27 miles, which is a rounder figure and is not used.

verifications.note: the Kinder Morgan page for its Southern Natural Gas system, which says the system is approximately 6,900 miles

resolutions.researcher_notes: Kinder Morgan, the owner and operator, describes Southern Natural Gas as an approximately 6,900-mile pipeline system on its own pipeline page. The sheet held 12231 km, which is a conversion of the 7,600 miles that a 2016 Jones Day deal summary gave. The operator's current figure is used because an owner or operator is the more official source and the length has changed since 2016. The Jones Day summary is not proposed as a reference because it states a different value.

verifications.note: the Southern Star company website, who we are page
a Wikipedia article, used as a last resort

resolutions.researcher_notes: Units restored. The sheet held 9334 km, which is a conversion of the miles the source states. Southern Star says it has more than 5,800 miles of transmission pipeline. The Wikipedia infobox says about 5,800. The sheet 9,334 km is 5,800 miles converted. The company page says more than, so the figure is a round one.

resolutions.pipeline_name: Eastern Gas Transmission and Storage System (EGTS)

verifications.note: The BHE GT&S page for EGTS says it operates nearly 4,000 miles of pipeline in six states.
a Pennsylvania Chamber of Business and Industry profile of Eastern Gas Transmission and Storage

resolutions.researcher_notes: Units restored and the length set to 4,000 miles, as Baird asked on 14 October 2026. The sheet held 6437.38 km, which is exactly 4,000 miles converted. The BHE GT&S page for EGTS says it operates nearly 4,000 miles of pipeline in six states. A Pennsylvania Chamber of Business and Industry profile says the same. The Berkshire Hathaway Energy annual report for 2025 gives about 3,900 miles for EGTS, so it is not cited for 4,000. All three figures are for the whole system, while this row is named Main Line.
